name: WriteToWordDocument
label: Write to Word Document
description: Writes or appends text to a Word file.

fields.name: WordInstance
fields.label: Word Instance
fields.description: The specific Word instance to use.

fields.name: TextToWrite
fields.label: Text to Write
fields.description: The text to be written or appended to the Word document.

fields.name: AppendNewLine
fields.label: Append New Line
fields.description: Specifies whether to append a new line after the text.

fields.name: WriteTextTo
fields.label: Write Text To
fields.description: Specifies the location in the Word document where the text should be written.

selectOptions.label: Beginning of Word file
selectOptions.description: Writes content at the beginning of the document.

selectOptions.label: End of Word file
selectOptions.description: Writes content at the end of the document.

selectOptions.label: Before Bookmark
selectOptions.description: Writes content before the specified bookmark.

selectOptions.label: After Bookmark
selectOptions.description: Writes content after the specified bookmark.

fields.name: BookmarkName
fields.label: Bookmark Name
fields.description: The name of the bookmark to use when writing before or after a bookmark.
